image_manifest.description: A 3D rendered asset manifest showing the aerial Pterosaur Racing Referee at the finish line judging a tie race from her hang glider, holding both silver trophies securely in one hand.

assets.name: Pterosaur Race Referee
assets.description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist with braided black hair and African ethnicity (dino_bones_paleontologist_6). She is wearing a bright yellow aerial safety helmet with strap details, a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts, and black hiking boots. She is seated safely in a harness attached to a hang glider. One hand holds firmly onto the hang glider control bar for flight stability, while her other hand holds two identical small silver trophies side-by-side to indicate a tied race. She has a pleasantly surprised, joyful expression.

assets.name: Hang Glider
assets.description: A high-visibility, lightweight hang glider with a bright yellow and red wing frame keeping the referee safely suspended mid-air at the finish line.

assets.name: Tie-Game Trophies
assets.description: Two identical, small silver trophies held together firmly by their bases in one hand, reflecting light in the sun.

assets.name: Aerial Finish Line Environment
assets.description: High-altitude open sky near dramatic Cretaceous canyon cliffs with a festive floating archway marking the aerial finish line, under bright sunlight.

assets.name: Visual Effects
assets.description: Sparkling lens flares glinting off both silver trophies, wind swirl effects around the glider wings, and colorful confetti drifting in the updrafts.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.

image_manifest.constraints: No people other than the referee. Square aspect ratio, 1:1. Focus entirely on the referee holding both silver trophies in one hand while keeping her other hand on the control bar. Ensure safety helmet is clearly visible. No ID labels, text overlays, title bars, or borders.
